name: sage-gate1-pre-decision
description: Deterministically invokes the SageReasoning practice across the whole task loop (control-flow, not prompt guidance). H1 (UserPromptSubmit) + H2 (PreToolUse/Task|Agent) fire the pre-decision Stoic frame before the agent and each subagent reasons. H3 (PreToolUse/Bash|Edit|Write…) is the at-action R5 cadence — a guardrail that blocks a do_not_proceed on irreversible actions, a deduped Gate-2 consult, and loop-closure. H4 (Stop) initiates reflect-at-close and writes the session's accreditation provenance. Fail-open with an honest log by default (the guard blocks a genuine do_not_proceed; configurable strict). Consult credential from SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL; H4's accreditation write uses a separate non-marker SAGE_GATE1_ACCRED_CREDENTIAL + SAGE_GATE1_AGENT_ID — never bundled. (H1/H2 live; H3/H4 built dark, activated at install.)
